changes.reason: Add an energy-frozen window covering every compared target state (≤ E_F+2 eV) plus a margin. frozen_capacity confirms at most 6 states at any k-point, within the 6.73 eV limit.

diagnosis: The subspace selection is the problem, not the minimisation. Both stages converged cleanly. The deck sets no frozen energy window (dis_froz_max unset), so the only states it pins are those with projectability ≥ 0.99, which are very few. As a result nothing forces the model to reproduce the parent bands, even deep below E_F. band_error_by_energy shows errors of about 1.2–1.5 eV in band 5 (−8 to −3 eV) and band 7 (−3.3 to 0.1 eV). It also shows the sixth function (4s-like, spread 2.0 Å² against 0.5 Å² for the five d functions) mixing with high-lying states: the model band rises to about 20 eV and is wrong by up to 3.5 eV near E_F. The frontier's ladder only ever moved the projectability thresholds. Lowering dis_proj_max (more states frozen) improved the RMS from 455 to 80 meV, which is the same mechanism, but the ladder never added an energy-frozen window. frozen_capacity shows a window from the bottom of the kept bands up to E_F+2 eV holds at most 6 states at the worst k-point and spin, and up to E_F+6.73 eV still fits. So freezing everything up to E_F+2.5 eV is possible. It covers every compared target state (≤ E_F+2 eV) with some margin and contains E_F.

model_bands_correspond_to_parent_bands.note: 0 of 22956 inside 9.22..20.04 eV sit further than 83 meV from any band the parent calculation has; bands 1-4 excluded by the deck and not counted (isolated 45.56 eV below the represented manifold)
